hakutakuSpend.note: myUsage month delta over the whole suite, includes seeding and grader reads; any other use of the same member in that window is included

adjudication.note: Every failing numbers_only_from / no_new_numbers check was reviewed by hand. The extra numbers are values and dates quoted from other [hk-bench] documents in the same brain (saved by save-then-find runs of this or earlier runs), one character count from a tool result, and digits of a run id; none is an invented value for the fact asked. The pre-registered F counts them; F_fabricated does not. X_ownSave counts session-B answers whose tool results contained the marker saved by its own session A (stricter than X, which another run of the same task can satisfy).
